collision_assumption: Computational SHA-256 collision resistance for standard-domain framed messages, supported by the stated backward finite-chain collision witness argument; no unconditional collision freedom or authenticity claim. Exact reconstruction comparison remains necessary.
diagnostic_transform: Official language-1.2 migration in a separate copy; executable definitions and a rust-std production root admitting allocation, overflow and recursion. Repository language, release locks and policy are unchanged.

function_binding.role: Exact function layout in the bound diagnostic package only, not a stable SDK API. The validation client contains no hash implementation.

native_results.protocols: invalid limits and offsets, unstarted/zero-fuel finalization, late updates, pending work, canonical canceled state errors and exact maximum byte-count/footer encoding

proof_scope: General framing-size identities, ready/finalizing count-guard reflection and cancellation erasure/idempotence; exact domain/prefix/limit/full-frame observations. Finite runtime controls are not a universal SHA correctness, transition-preservation or collision-reduction theorem. No injectivity axiom or custom axiom is introduced.
remaining_acceptance: Full pinned-SDK just vv and integrated BinaryProgram/archive acceptance remain separate; issue #43 stays open. General transition-preservation and a kernel-checked collision reduction are not claimed.
role: Source-bound diagnostic observation, not release acceptance under the immutable prismpm.lock.

generated_lean_results.scope: All source-owned diagnostic Lean cases through 4096 bytes; the distinct Rust inventory covers all 94 through 1 MiB. No production input limit is introduced.
